name: mimu-geonode-myanmar-self-administered-regions-boundaries-mimu
notes:
Myanmar self administered regions boundaries (polygons), based on the latest MIMU Pcode version 9.4 .
Place names from General Administration Department (GAD), are available in Myanmar Unicode. Transliteration in roman script by MIMU.  

Place names are in line with the general cartographic practice to reflect the names of such places as designated by the host governments.
